note: Pinned corpora in canonical system-header mode with the embedded models. Recaptured after rebasing onto local master bb64b1e on Windows 11 x64 with MSYS2 MinGW GCC 15.2.0. Header-dependent totals use that toolchain as the reference. Counts include the 2026-11-20 vector specialization audit. See docs/EVAL_REPORT.md.

probes.name: DecodedEvent array lookup reaches only its four local lambdas
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 4 AND SUM(t.name GLOB c.name || '::$lambda*') = 4 FROM call_edges e JOIN call_sites s ON s.id = e.call_site_id JOIN functions c ON c.id = e.caller_fn_id JOIN functions t ON t.id = e.callee_fn_id JOIN files p ON p.id = s.file_id WHERE p.path LIKE '%decoded_event.cpp' AND s.line = 162 AND c.name LIKE '%::AppendCustomizedArrayParam' AND e.resolution = 'indirect'

probes.name: DecodedEvent scalar lookup reaches only its four local lambdas
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 4 AND SUM(t.name GLOB c.name || '::$lambda*') = 4 FROM call_edges e JOIN call_sites s ON s.id = e.call_site_id JOIN functions c ON c.id = e.caller_fn_id JOIN functions t ON t.id = e.callee_fn_id JOIN files p ON p.id = s.file_id WHERE p.path LIKE '%decoded_event.cpp' AND s.line = 201 AND c.name LIKE '%::AppendCustomizedParam' AND e.resolution = 'indirect'

probes.name: DecodedEvent forwards param to every local lambda
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.formal_var_id) FROM arg_flow_edges a JOIN call_sites s ON s.id = a.call_site_id JOIN files p ON p.id = s.file_id JOIN functions c ON c.id = s.caller_fn_id JOIN variables u ON u.id = a.actual_var_id JOIN variables v ON v.id = a.formal_var_id JOIN functions t ON t.id = v.fn_id WHERE p.path LIKE '%decoded_event.cpp' AND s.line IN (162, 201) AND c.name LIKE '%::DecodedEvent::AppendCustomized%Param' AND a.arg_index = 0 AND u.fn_id = c.id AND u.name = 'param' AND v.name = 'param' AND t.name GLOB c.name || '::$lambda*'
